notes.title: The Woods - Release date and price
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11433209/f6b83f8c30393d8c35fa761eb34659bc21972dd9.jpg

Hello everyone! We're excited to announce that The Woods: VR Escape the Room will be releasing next Thursday, April 4th, 2019!

It will be releasing for $4.99 with a 40% launch discount. 

Be sure to wishlist the game so you don't miss it!
